sections.title: Hyperrealistic
sections.description: I enjoy the process of just getting to observe something and recreating it, slowly, taking as much time as I need and going in as much detail as I'd like to. These works are either recreations of incredible artists I was inspired by, or photographers whose works I found to be great subjects. I'm incredibly grateful for the work they produced! Wherever possible, I've included the original inspirations along with my recreations.

sections.title: Abstract
sections.description: A few completely original pieces are shown below, created using textures and acrylics. Beyond those, I love exploring geometric designs, especially Islamic geometric patterns. Discovering new ways (mostly to me) in which different parts of a sketch can connect, while maintaining symmetry is very exciting for me. Sometimes the pattern can be inspired, but usually it's original. When it comes to filling the patterns in, I simply take as much time as I want to.

sections.title: Typography
sections.description: Although I've been doing typography since 2016, I haven't taken many pictures of my older works from back then. This is one of my recent works which I did for a competition on a T-shirt. The theme for the competition was: Words beyond Borders. These lyrics from the song, Zariya by A.R. Rahman, Ani Choying Drolma and Farah Siraj seemed perfect!
